Titel: Cloud Migration Programme Lead (AWS), 12-Month Contract
Unternehmen: Aarewald Versicherungen AG
Ort: Bern, Bern, Switzerland
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4193380415/
Abgerufen am: 24.09.2026 07:39

About the job
Aarewald Versicherungen is a Swiss property and life insurer with 2,300 employees. By the end of 2027 we are moving our core insurance platform and around 190 further workloads from two on-premises data centres to AWS (region Zurich). We are looking for an experienced programme lead to take the migration from the landing zone to the last decommissioned rack.

Your responsibilities
Lead the cloud migration programme across five migration waves and the landing zone team
Own the programme plan, the budget of CHF 24m and the benefits tracking
Coordinate the AWS partner, the internal platform engineering team and the application owners
Ensure compliance with FINMA outsourcing requirements and Swiss data residency rules
Drive the decommissioning of the legacy data centres and the exit from the related contracts

Your profile
Senior programme manager with at least two large cloud migrations delivered, AWS preferred
Background in financial services, ideally insurance
Strong stakeholder management up to C-level
An AWS Solutions Architect certification is an advantage
Fluent in English and German; French is a plus

Terms
Contract, freelance or via a staffing partner, 12 months with extension option
Start in January 2027
Bern, 3 days per week on site
Rate CHF 1,350 to 1,550 per day

Seniority level
Mid-Senior level

Employment type
Contract

Job function
Project Management and Information Technology

Industries
Insurance
